name: Tokyo & Kyoto
about: Cherry blossoms (Mar–Apr) and fall foliage (Oct–Nov) are the celebrated, crowded peaks; rainy season hits June, typhoons Aug–Sep.
overview: Japan's essential two-city pairing — 2.5 hours apart by bullet train.
costOverview: Ramen is cheap and filling — easy to eat extremely well without spending much, unless you seek out fine sushi.

specialSeasons.text: Cherry blossoms (sakura) are in bloom — one of the most celebrated, and crowded, times to visit.
Fall foliage (koyo) is at its peak in both cities.
